name: English Pound Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one and one-quarter pounds of flour
ingredients.originalText: one and one-quarter pounds of flour

ingredients.name: pounded loaf sugar
ingredients.originalText: one pound of pounded loaf sugar

instructions.text: Work the butter to a cream; add the sugar, then the well-beaten yolks of eggs.
Next add the flour, currants, candied peel which should be cut into neat slices, and the almonds which should be blanched and chopped, and mix all these well together.
Whisk the whites of eggs and let them be thoroughly blended with the other ingredients.
Beat the cake well for twenty minutes and put it into a round tin, lined at the bottom and sides with strips of white buttered paper.
Bake it from two hours to two and a half, and let the oven be well heated when the cake is first put in.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Work the butter to a cream; add the sugar, then the well-beaten yolks of eggs.
2. Next add the flour, currants, candied peel which should be cut into neat slices, and the almonds which should be blanched and chopped, and mix all these well together.
3. Whisk the whites of eggs and let them be thoroughly blended with the other ingredients.
4. Beat the cake well for twenty minutes and put it into a round tin, lined at the bottom and sides with strips of white buttered paper.
5. Bake it from two hours to two and a half, and let the oven be well heated when the cake is first put in.
